title: Control Plane: Oversized Payload Rejected
description: Spike of HTTP 413 responses — the SEC-6 body-size boundary is rejecting oversized mutating payloads, which can indicate a resource-exhaustion or smuggling attempt against the ingestion edge.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Control Plane Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Control Plane Access Logs') and ('Status Code' = 413) | stats count as rejected by 'Source IP' | where rejected > 5
falsepositives: A legitimate large bulk-import exceeding the configured cap
